content.user_title: Migrate Legacy Azure CallingServer Java Code
content.value_statement: Deprecated CallingServer projects need clear migration guidance. This skill maps key dependencies, clients, and recording concepts to Azure Call Automation.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the deprecated CallingServer Maven dependency and its Call Automation replacement.
Maps legacy client, builder, connection, and server call class names to current equivalents.
Shows legacy and replacement Java client construction patterns.
Summarizes legacy recording start, pause, resume, and stop operations.
Directs new development toward the dedicated Call Automation Java skill.
limitations: Does not cover every CallingServer API or provide a complete automated migration.
Uses fixed dependency versions that require verification against current Azure releases.
Does not modify projects, run builds, or test deployed communication workflows.
Provides limited Call Automation implementation detail beyond dependency and client migration.

use_cases.title: Maintain a Legacy Service
use_cases.description: Identify deprecated dependencies and understand existing CallingServer client or recording code.

use_cases.title: Plan an SDK Migration
use_cases.description: Create a focused checklist for replacing CallingServer dependencies and core classes.

use_cases.title: Review Legacy Changes
use_cases.description: Check whether proposed code continues deprecated usage or moves toward Call Automation.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Deprecated Usage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Maven dependency or Java class name. Explain whether it belongs to CallingServer and name the documented replacement.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Migration Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration checklist for this legacy CallingServer project. Cover dependencies, client builders, call connections, and required verification.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Client Construction
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this legacy CallingServer client setup with the Call Automation pattern. Explain each required class and configuration change.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Recording Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this legacy recording workflow. Separate documented CallingServer behavior from Call Automation details that require current Azure documentation.

output_examples.input: Is the CallingServer Maven artifact suitable for a new project?
output_examples.output: No. The artifact is deprecated. Use the Azure Communication Call Automation package and verify its current stable version.
CallAutomationClientBuilder is the documented replacement. Review constructor and credential requirements before changing production code.

output_examples.input: Summarize the legacy recording operations shown by this skill.
output: Start recording with options that include a callback URI.
Use the identifier to pause, resume, or stop recording.

best_practices: Use this skill only for legacy maintenance or migration analysis.
Verify dependency versions and replacement APIs against current official Azure documentation.
Test credentials, callback endpoints, and recording state transitions in a controlled environment.
anti_patterns: Do not start new projects with the deprecated CallingServer SDK.
Do not copy fixed dependency versions without checking current supported releases.
Do not assume every legacy class or recording method has a direct replacement.

faq.question: Is CallingServer recommended for new Java projects?
faq.answer: No. Use Azure Communication Call Automation for new development.

faq.question: Can this skill migrate an entire project automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides targeted mappings and examples for manual migration planning.

faq.question: Which Maven artifact replaces CallingServer?
faq.answer: The documented replacement is azure-communication-callautomation. Verify the current version before use.

faq.question: Does the CallConnection class name change?
faq.answer: The skill shows CallConnection with the same class name, but package and behavior changes still require review.

faq.question: Does this skill cover current recording implementation?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes legacy recording operations and directs current implementation work to Call Automation guidance.

faq.question: Will this skill run commands or edit my repository?
faq.answer: No. It contains documentation examples and does not execute commands or modify files.
